definitions: Have or keep a supply of (something) for use or sale.
Provide (a store or other establishment) with a stock of goods.
Fill (a pond, river, or other body of water) with fish.
Fit (a rifle or other firearm) with a stock.
examples: The shop stocks a wide range of goods.
They stock the lake with trout.
He stocked his pantry with essentials.
The gun was stocked with a fine walnut.
